credential_transport: Mini resolves ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from existing host process environment, then supplies it to agent exec. Do not put secret values in --ae or JobConfig. Public route values must be --ae because generated review wrapper does not inherit reviewed task.toml environment.
review_semantics: harbor check creates ephemeral wrapper task per reviewed task and copies original task into environment/task; original files are not mounted writable or edited.
Wrapper agent timeout is1800sec and verifier120sec; these are quality-review budgets, not changes to the benchmark task budgets.
run_checks calls normal Job.create and Job.run, so process-local TrialQueue resource admission/deadline/Mini hooks apply when invoked via harbor-resource-runner.py.
Unmanaged check-task cells acquire normal shared slots and preserve the117-cell benchmark plan.
CLI --config base agents and environment are replaced by explicit CLI parameters; provide route values via --ae, not baseconfig agents.
Review reward1 means valid check-result.json schema, not that every rubric criterion passed; inspect check_report.json outcomes.
Ephemeral wrappers are deleted after run. Capture each original checksum/tree and generated wrapper inputs separately for proof if exact review provenance is needed.
Do not reuse execute_captured_runner.py from oracle/nop evidence unchanged: its model_calls:0 metadata is specific to zero-model controls. Create a separate review runner/proof.
